name: WiFi bring-up chain for sagit (msm8998, legacy ipc-router)
description: Installs the vendor service that starts the four host-side pieces the WCN3990 stack needs on this SoC before the modem can even be asked for WLAN: rfssrv2 (RFS/TFTP, serves wlanmdsp.mbn), wlq irsc (loads sec_config and releases the ipc-router IRSC port, without which every client send blocks forever), pdserve (host SERVREG_LOC 0x40:0101, the service-locator server that lets MPSS raise msm/modem/wlan_pd and publish WLFW 0x45) and rmt_storage (RMT STORAGE 0x0e:1, without which MPSS self-SSRs about 40 s after boot). It then holds /dev/subsys_modem open and parks, because closing that fd powers MPSS down and WLAN with it. The board data download itself is kernel side: src/kernel/sagit/patches/0001. See docs/devices/sagit/wifi.md.
